limitations: No optimal second-order coefficient or classification of extremizers is proved. The theorem is restricted to smooth closed Riemannian manifolds of dimension at least two.

record_title: The Euclidean Jung constant is the universal local Hausdorff–Gromov–Hausdorff constant
